course_name_original: Laboratory of sustainable glasses and binders (146185)
course_name_en: Laboratory of sustainable glasses and binders

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire basic skills in conducting experimental laboratory activities, data processing, and analytical techniques useful for characterizing inorganic materials.
Acquire knowledge of the processing methods and engineering properties of vitreous (glass) materials and binders.

syllabus_topics: production and characterization of low-melting-point and low-environmental-impact glasses
techniques for improving the chemical or mechanical resistance of glass components
assessment_rules: Students will be required to prepare an oral presentation on the laboratory activities, which will be discussed during the exam.
bibliography: J. E. Shelby, Introduction to Glass Science, The Royal Society of Chemistry, Cambridge, UK.
G. Scarinci, T. Toninato, B. Locardi, Vetri, Casa Editrice Ambrosiana, Milan.
W. Smith, Scienza e Tecnologia dei Materiali, McGraw-Hill.
W. D. Callister, Materials Science and Engineering: An Introduction, Wiley & Sons (any edition).
Shelby, J. E. (2021). Introduction to glass science and technology (3rd ed.). Royal society of chemistry.
Scarinci, G., Toninato, T., & Locardi, B. (1977). Vetri. CEA.
Smith, W. F., Tanzi, M. C., Faré, S., Hashemi, J., & Presuel-Moreno, F. (2021). Scienza e tecnologia dei materiali (5. ed.). McGraw-Hill.
Callister, W. D. (2020). Materials science and engineering : an introduction (10th ed.). Wiley.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Industriale (Industrial Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
